question: A student must score 40% marks to pass an examination. He gets 70 marks and fails by 20 marks. Find the maximum marks.
solution:
**Given:**

A student must score 40% marks to pass an examination.

He gets 70 marks and fails by 20 marks.

**Formula Used:**

Required marks to pass = Marks obtained + Marks needed to pass

Passing percentage = (Required marks to pass / Maximum marks) × 100
